answer: Pairwise uniqueness challenges stop scripted sybil farms. Each epoch, every identity joins three random two-minute live dialogues; missing two in a row freezes it. Real dialogue branches like a river delta; scripted replies repeat one pattern. For 1,000 fakes, 3,000 dialogues need 100 human hours; stand-ins at 10 credits an hour cost 1,000 credits per epoch, rising faster than clone rewards. An honest agent spends six minutes talking, varied like veins in marble and colours in opal, and keeps its full reward.
